_about: Inverse and symmetry declarations for the JungKG query layer, transcribed from docs/FAMILY_DEFINITIONS.md. This file is data, not a reasoner: nothing here rewrites seed.json, and no transitivity is declared on any relation or family (FAMILY_DEFINITIONS line 749: 'No transitivity on any family; symmetry and inverses only as declared'). tools/query/kg_query.py reads `active` at query time and labels every row it derives from a declaration; `candidates_awaiting_ruling` is inert and is read by nothing, so adopting one of those pairs is a human decision recorded here first, never a build side effect.

transcribed_from.line_numbers: 1-based, against the document as committed at the base commit above

reading_rules.effective_relation: A declaration matches an edge on its EFFECTIVE relation: relation_normalized.relation where that layer exists, else the verbatim relation (FAMILY_DEFINITIONS line 112-114).
reading_rules.inverse: Given a declaration {forward: A, inverse: B}, an edge (s, A, o) licenses a derived row (o, B, s), and an edge (s, B, o) licenses a derived row (o, A, s). The derived row is labelled and is never written back to the graph.
reading_rules.symmetric: Given {relation: R}, an edge (s, R, o) licenses a derived row (o, R, s), labelled the same way.
reading_rules.applies_to_family: null means the declaration is on the relation strings themselves, as the precedents table states them. A family name means the document restricted the declaration to edges assigned that family, and the restriction is enforced at read time.
reading_rules.dormant: true when at least one string in the entry has no edge in the current graph. A dormant entry stays declared and derives nothing until the string appears.
reading_rules.carried_qualifier: A declaration may carry a `carried_qualifier` string. Every row derived from it displays the qualifier beside the derived relation, so the flip asserts no more than the stored edge does. The governing principle (editorial ruling, 2026-08-13): a derived row must carry everything the stored row asserted; if the flip cannot carry a qualifier, the declaration is not made.

Some symbolized-by edges are assigned doctrinal-attribution under the attribution-outranks-the-verb rule (line 669-677); the inverse still holds of the string, and the derived row carries whatever family its source edge carries.

source.quote: **Inverse pair declared:** `produces` / `originates-in` (alongside produces/produced-by) — `projection originates-in the-unconscious` (9ii §17) and `god-image originates-in psychoid` (14 §787) are generation, inverse direction; only tradition-to-tradition `originates-in` (per §14's relation test) is derivation.

active.note: The family restriction is the document's own: an originates-in edge assigned derivation transmits a doctrine and is not the inverse of a begetting. The restriction is applied to the source edge, so a derivation-assigned originates-in edge derives nothing.

source.quote: **Inverse pair declared:** `manifests-as` / `is-aspect-of` (with `is-manifestation-of`) — the aspect strings run the SAME relation in the inverse direction (the subject is the partial showing, the object the content shown: `lilith is-aspect-of adam`), and the inverse declaration handles them without breaking the direction test.

active.note: Active since b-cw11-12 (commit d1ea15e, 2026-10-23): the first is-manifestation-of edge (consciousness is-manifestation-of soul, CW 11 §838) ended the dormancy recorded at the 2026-08-13 transcription. The declaration itself is unchanged.

source.quote: Symmetric in principle; `synonym-of` carries the `owl:SymmetricProperty` precedent.

active.note: The document says archetypal-identity is symmetric IN PRINCIPLE and gives the precedent to one string. Only synonym-of is declared here. Nothing licenses symmetry on is-identified-with, identified-with or is-identical-with, so those derive nothing.
Activated by the 2026-08-13 ruling (see `rulings`). Lossless flip: no qualifier to carry.
Activated by the 2026-08-13 ruling WITH the qualifier carried: a derived manifests-as row from an is-dark-aspect-of edge displays 'dark aspect', so nothing falls off in the turn.

candidates_awaiting_ruling.why_inert: FAMILY_DEFINITIONS never declares this pair. `precedes` is one of the four standing proofs that assignment is edge-level (line 336-344): it distributes between sequence and dependence per edge, and the sequence family carries an explicit no-transitivity note (line 588, the uroboros argument). An inverse over a string that spans two families would be a ruling, not a transcription.

Not declared in FAMILY_DEFINITIONS. Kinship (family 20) and generation (family 13) both touch parent/child language and the document splits them by act versus standing role (line 553-556, 646-647); which family a declared inverse would sit in is unruled.
Not declared in FAMILY_DEFINITIONS. Same unruled boundary as mother-of/child-of, with the added point that child-of would then be the inverse of two different forward strings.
Not declared in FAMILY_DEFINITIONS. Both strings are listed under telos (line 615-617) but the document declares no inverse pair in that entry.

Ruled against, in effect: `exemplified-by` is recorded as a HOMELESS string with its family decision left open (line 782-787, the v0.6 ruling of 2026-08-10). Declaring it the inverse of exemplifies would give it a family through the back door.

Not declared in FAMILY_DEFINITIONS. Composition takes either direction with the verb settling which (line 484-486), and the composition/structural-position rule (line 266-277) routes some containment language to position, so the pair spans a boundary the document has not ruled on for this purpose.

rulings.ruling: The middle ruling on the doc-listed manifestation inverse strings: `aspect-of` activates as a plain inverse of manifests-as (lossless flip); `is-dark-aspect-of` activates WITH its qualifier carried — derived rows display 'dark aspect' so the reverse reading stays exactly as strong as Jung's stored assertion. General principle adopted as precedent for all future strings: a derived row must carry everything the stored row asserted; if the flip cannot carry a qualifier, the declaration is not made.
